# Disabling grid column menus leaves a retired trigger in the vnode

Delivered by #20546, merged by Tobias at `185b025515800c91b88ff74f7f58ff0167e7590c` on 7 November 2026. The repair and regression match reviewed/tested `2148a3675a` exactly. Julia verified all three ACs in [review 5813997534](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20546#pullrequestreview-5813997534). Standalone #20565 was superseded; no acceptance remains on this leaf.

## Context

While clearing v13.4 CI on `#20546`, [engine shard 7/8](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/42387180686/job/128447046903) failed `BigDataNL.spec.mjs:47` after toggling Column menus. The worker-error fixture captured 51 identical `util.VNode.getVnode: Component not found for id: neo-button-38` errors. The Demo B extraction changes no implicated grid/test source.

## The Problem

The browser failure is intermittent (10 local exact-head repetitions passed), but the stale reference is deterministic at `2505e5b54a` with actual Engine classes:

1. Construct a one-column grid with `columnMenu: true`, await its menu plugin, initialize its vnode, mount it and await `headerToolbar.promiseUpdate()`.
2. Confirm `VNode.createMap(grid.vnode)` contains the menu trigger.
3. Set `grid.columnMenu = false`.
4. The trigger and plugin are gone from the registry, but the header vnode still carries the trigger's component reference. An immediate `VNode.createMap(grid.vnode)` throws the same missing-component error.

## The Architectural Reality

`src/grid/header/plugin/Menu.mjs#destroy` manually removes the trigger from `owner.vdom.cn`, then calls `trigger.destroy()`. It does not retire the reference in the owner's already-rendered vnode.

`src/component/Abstract.mjs#destroy(updateParentVdom, silent)` already owns both parent-VDOM removal and synchronous retired-reference cleanup. `VNode.unlinkRetiredReferences` intentionally does not follow live component references: a toolbar cannot repair a live header's stale child on its behalf.

Design authority: the existing component destruction contract and `#19757` AC-2 require runtime menu toggling to work. Julia's merged `#20116` fixed the same invariant for replaced header buttons in Wrapper; this is the plugin-trigger callsite.

Prescription checked: `src/component/Abstract.mjs#destroy` owns the concern. Consume its existing parent-removal contract from Menu, retaining the plugin's batched owner update. Do not weaken strict VNode traversal.

## The Fix

Replace the menu plugin's manual trigger removal with the existing component destruction contract. Extend `test/playwright/unit/grid/HeaderMenu.spec.mjs` with a rendered disable/re-enable case that traverses the ancestor vnode synchronously after retirement.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] AC-1: Disabling column menus on a rendered grid immediately removes retired trigger references from the header vnode; ancestor traversal succeeds before a later projection can mask the fault.
- [x] AC-2: Menu disable/re-enable preserves trigger ownership, store/filter intent and clean subsequent projection, without changing wrapper or lazy-loading behavior.
- [x] AC-3: The new regression fails on the unchanged base and passes with the repair; existing HeaderMenu units and the BigData Column menus browser test pass without waived errors or retries.

## Out of Scope

Demo B extraction, cross-parent grid moves, general VNode walker behavior, menu enable root transitions, test retries and error suppression. No new API or user obligation.

## Avoided Traps

A green rerun does not repair the stale reference. Preserve the invariant at the retiring owner instead of recursively cleaning unrelated live components, catching the error or adding a timeout.
